ex.en: He got a master's degree in law.
ex.zh: 他拿到了法學碩士學位。

ex.en: She has a degree in computer science.
ex.zh: 她擁有資訊工程學位。

ex.en: An angle of 90 degrees is called a right angle.
ex.zh: 90 度的角叫做直角。

ex.en: Today, the temperature rose as high as 30 degrees Celsius.
ex.zh: 今天氣溫高達攝氏 30 度。

ex.en: To what degree are you interested in baseball?
ex.zh: 你對棒球有多大的興趣？

ex.en: To what degree can we trust him?
ex.zh: 我們可以相信他到什麼程度？

ex.en: This electrical device must have been damaged during delivery.
ex.zh: 這台電器一定是在運送途中損壞的。

ex.en: The reimagined user interface allows smoother play across devices.
ex.zh: 全新設計的操作介面，讓你在不同裝置上都能玩得更順暢。

ex.en: The device is attached fast to the ceiling.
ex.zh: 這個裝置被牢牢固定在天花板上。

ex.en: Delete his name from the list of the applicants.
ex.zh: 把他的名字從應徵者名單上刪掉。

ex.en: I wish I could figure out how to delete my Facebook account.
ex.zh: 真希望我知道怎麼刪除臉書帳號。

ex.en: Delete Tom's name from the list.
ex.zh: 從名單上刪掉湯姆的名字。

ex.en: Most developers hate debugging; it's more fun to create bugs than to correct them.
ex.zh: 大部分開發者都討厭除錯；寫出 bug 比修 bug 有趣多了。

ex.en: It took me two hours to debug the program.
ex.zh: 我花了兩個小時幫這個程式除錯。

ex.en: Our country designed the first electronic computer in 1941.
ex.zh: 我們國家在 1941 年設計出第一台電子計算機。

ex.en: My friend is designing a user interface for the new operating system.
ex.zh: 我朋友正在為新的作業系統設計使用者介面。

ex.en: These dresses were designed by the same designer.
ex.zh: 這幾件衣服是同一位設計師設計的。

ex.en: Tom's designs didn't impress me much.
ex.zh: 湯姆的設計沒給我留下什麼印象。

ex.en: He studies French and web design.
ex.zh: 他在學法文和網頁設計。

ex.en: Palm oil production is the leading cause of deforestation in Indonesia.
ex.zh: 棕櫚油生產是印尼森林砍伐的主要原因。

ex.en: Deforestation destroys the homes of many animals.
ex.zh: 森林砍伐摧毀了許多動物的棲地。

ex.en: Tom says that Mary definitely won't accept the job.
ex.zh: 湯姆說瑪麗絕對不會接受這份工作。

ex.en: This year is definitely a special year in human history.
ex.zh: 今年肯定是人類歷史上特殊的一年。

ex.en: We can now say definitely that this hypothesis holds water.
ex.zh: 我們現在能肯定地說，這個假設是成立的。

ex.en: I'm trying to save room for dessert.
ex.zh: 我要留點肚子吃甜點。

ex.en: I'd like to have cake for dessert.
ex.zh: 我想吃蛋糕當甜點。

ex.en: The moment I see dessert, I can't hold back.
ex.zh: 一看到甜點，我就無法自拔。

ex.en: My father made me a delicious lunch.
ex.zh: 我爸爸幫我做了一頓好吃的午餐。

ex.en: The food in the cafeteria is cheap, and it's delicious.
ex.zh: 員工餐廳的飯菜便宜又好吃。

ex.en: Thank you for baking this delicious cake.
ex.zh: 謝謝你烤了這麼好吃的蛋糕。

ex.en: I decluttered my closet and gave away old clothes.
ex.zh: 我整理了衣櫥，把舊衣服送人。

ex.en: Decluttering your home can reduce stress.
ex.zh: 清理家中雜物可以減輕壓力。

ex.en: This system has obvious defects.
ex.zh: 這個系統有明顯的缺陷。

ex.en: This system is bristling with defects and drawbacks.
ex.zh: 這個系統有許多缺陷和不足之處。

ex.en: Demand for occupational therapy has surged in recent years.
ex.zh: 近年來職能治療的需求大幅增加。

ex.en: There is close relationship between supply and demand.
ex.zh: 供給和需求之間的關係非常密切。

ex.en: He demanded that I should pay the money at once.
ex.zh: 他要求我馬上付錢。

ex.en: The English ambassador demanded to meet with the President directly.
ex.zh: 英國大使要求直接和總統見面。

ex.en: We will never give in to terrorist demands.
ex.zh: 我們絕不會向恐怖分子的要求屈服。

ex.en: The workers' main demand is higher pay.
ex.zh: 工人的主要訴求是加薪。

demographic.zh: 族群（依年齡、性別等劃分）

ex.en: This app is popular with a younger demographic.
ex.zh: 這個 App 很受年輕族群歡迎。

ex.en: Our main demographic is women aged 25 to 40.
ex.zh: 我們的主要客群是 25 到 40 歲的女性。

ex.en: Demographic changes affect the job market.
ex.zh: 人口結構的變化會影響就業市場。

ex.en: We collected demographic data from the survey.
ex.zh: 我們從問卷中收集了人口統計資料。

ex.en: Those two departments are sometimes at odds with each other.
ex.zh: 那兩個部門有時意見不合。

ex.en: He is the manager of the marketing department.
ex.zh: 他是行銷部的經理。

ex.en: He is a tutor for the math department.
ex.zh: 他是數學系的助教。

ex.en: She teaches in the English department.
ex.zh: 她在英文系任教。

ex.en: She got out of the taxi at the department store.
ex.zh: 她在百貨公司門前下了計程車。

ex.en: There is a bookstore in front of the department store.
ex.zh: 百貨公司前面有一家書店。

ex.en: The family is too poor to pay back the debts.
ex.zh: 這家人太窮了，還不起債。

ex.en: There are people drowning in debt.
ex.zh: 有些人債台高築。

ex.en: I am free of debt.
ex.zh: 我沒有負債。

ex.en: The company defaulted on its loans.
ex.zh: 那家公司拖欠貸款。

ex.en: If you default, the bank can take your house.
ex.zh: 如果違約，銀行可以收回你的房子。

ex.en: You can change the default settings in the menu.
ex.zh: 你可以在選單裡修改預設設定。

ex.en: English is the default language of the app.
ex.zh: 這個 App 的預設語言是英文。

ex.en: This phone is defective.
ex.zh: 這支手機有瑕疵。

ex.en: Some diseases are caused by a defective gene.
ex.zh: 有些疾病是基因缺陷造成的。

ex.en: Due to the worsening weather, the departure was delayed.
ex.zh: 由於天氣變差，出發延遲了。

ex.en: We postponed our departure because of the storm.
ex.zh: 我們因為暴風雨延後出發。

ex.en: He has postponed his departure until tomorrow.
ex.zh: 他把出發的時間延到明天了。

ex.en: The weather was bad so the plane was delayed.
ex.zh: 由於天氣惡劣，飛機延誤了。

ex.en: The train was delayed because of heavy snowfall.
ex.zh: 火車因為大雪而延誤了。

ex.en: An accident delayed us for half an hour.
ex.zh: 一場意外耽誤了我們半小時。

ex.en: The schedule is only slightly affected by this delay.
ex.zh: 這次延誤對時程的影響很小。

ex.en: I was late as a result of the train delay.
ex.zh: 由於火車延誤，我遲到了。

ex.en: When you safely arrive at your destination, don't forget to call me.
ex.zh: 你安全到達目的地以後，別忘記打個電話告訴我。

ex.en: They made straight for their destination.
ex.zh: 他們直奔目的地。

ex.en: The ship was on the point of arriving at her destination.
ex.zh: 這艘船就快抵達目的地了。

ex.en: You have to give three months' rent as a deposit.
ex.zh: 你必須付三個月的房租作為押金。

ex.en: The hotel asked for a deposit of 2,000 dollars.
ex.zh: 飯店要求付 2,000 元的押金。

ex.en: I made a deposit of $1,000 at the bank.
ex.zh: 我在銀行存了 1,000 美元。

ex.en: You can make a deposit at any ATM.
ex.zh: 你可以在任何一台提款機存款。

ex.en: He deposited the prize money in the bank.
ex.zh: 他把獎金存進銀行了。

ex.en: Some people do not like to deposit their money in banks.
ex.zh: 有些人不喜歡把錢存銀行。

ex.en: What percentage of all taxi drivers make unscrupulous detours, do you think?
ex.zh: 你覺得有多少比例的計程車司機會故意繞遠路？

ex.en: We took a detour because the bridge was closed.
ex.zh: 因為橋封閉了，我們繞道而行。

ex.en: Do you have anything to declare?
ex.zh: 您有任何東西要申報嗎？

ex.en: You must declare any goods over the duty-free limit.
ex.zh: 超過免稅額度的物品必須申報。

ex.en: The US declared independence from Great Britain in 1776.
ex.zh: 美國在 1776 年宣布脫離英國獨立。

ex.en: The country declared war against its neighbor.
ex.zh: 那個國家向鄰國宣戰了。

ex.en: Please fill out the customs declaration form.
ex.zh: 請填寫海關申報單。

ex.en: Your declaration must list all items you bought abroad.
ex.zh: 你的申報必須列出所有在國外購買的物品。

ex.en: The Declaration of Independence was signed in 1776.
ex.zh: 《獨立宣言》在 1776 年簽署。

ex.en: She made a public declaration of her support.
ex.zh: 她公開聲明支持。

ex.en: He was deported for working without a visa.
ex.zh: 他因為沒有簽證就工作而被驅逐出境。

ex.en: The government plans to deport illegal workers.
ex.zh: 政府計畫將非法勞工驅逐出境。

ex.en: Delegates from many countries participated in the conference.
ex.zh: 許多國家的代表出席了會議。

ex.en: Several delegates disagreed.
ex.zh: 幾位代表不同意。

ex.en: A good manager knows how to delegate tasks.
ex.zh: 好的主管懂得分派工作。

ex.en: She delegated the report to her assistant.
ex.zh: 她把報告交給助理負責。

ex.en: A recent survey shows that the number of smokers is decreasing.
ex.zh: 最近的調查顯示吸菸人數在減少。

ex.en: My income has decreased ten percent.
ex.zh: 我的收入減少了百分之十。

ex.en: Canada's crime rate is decreasing.
ex.zh: 加拿大的犯罪率下降了。

ex.en: We saw a sharp decrease in complaints this year.
ex.zh: 今年客訴明顯減少。

ex.en: The decrease in sales worried the manager.
ex.zh: 銷售量下滑讓經理很擔心。

ex.en: The main deliverable is a working prototype.
ex.zh: 主要的交付成果是一個可以運作的原型。

ex.en: Please list all deliverables and their due dates.
ex.zh: 請列出所有交付項目和截止日期。

ex.en: The postman delivers letters every morning.
ex.zh: 郵差每天早上送信。

ex.en: We can deliver within a week.
ex.zh: 我們一週內就能送貨。

ex.en: How soon can they be delivered?
ex.zh: 這些多快能送到？

ex.en: She delivered an excellent speech at the conference.
ex.zh: 她在研討會上發表了一場精彩的演說。

ex.en: The CEO will deliver the opening remarks.
ex.zh: 執行長將發表開幕致詞。

ex.en: The new manager delivered on all his promises.
ex.zh: 新經理實現了他所有的承諾。

ex.en: We need a team that can deliver results.
ex.zh: 我們需要一個能交出成果的團隊。

ex.en: Careful! Emotional dependency is not synonymous with love!
ex.zh: 小心！情感上的依賴不等於愛！

ex.en: Tom has a caffeine dependency, doesn't he?
ex.zh: 湯姆對咖啡因有依賴，對吧？

ex.en: This task has a dependency on the design team.
ex.zh: 這項工作要等設計團隊完成才能進行。

ex.en: List all dependencies before you set the timeline.
ex.zh: 排定時程前，先列出所有相依的工作。

ex.en: This electrical device must have been damaged during delivery.
ex.zh: 這台電器一定是在運送途中損壞的。

ex.en: I have missed the delivery time, what should I do next?
ex.zh: 我已經錯過交貨時間了，接下來該怎麼辦？

ex.en: The pizza delivery guy hasn't come by yet.
ex.zh: 送披薩的人還沒來。

ex.en: I don't make deals with people like you.
ex.zh: 我不跟你這種人做交易。

ex.en: We finally closed the deal with the new client.
ex.zh: 我們終於和新客戶談成了這筆交易。

ex.en: Tom could've dealt with the problem in a better way.
ex.zh: 湯姆其實可以用更好的方式處理這個問題。

ex.en: How long have you been dealing with this trouble?
ex.zh: 這個問題困擾你多久了？

ex.en: This book deals with life in the United Kingdom.
ex.zh: 這本書講的是英國的生活。

ex.en: We will deal with this problem in Chapter Three.
ex.zh: 我們會在第三章討論這個問題。

ex.en: We have to do a great deal of reading.
ex.zh: 我們要讀很多書。

ex.en: She knows a great deal about wine.
ex.zh: 她對葡萄酒懂得很多。

ex.en: There is a pair of scissors on the desk.
ex.zh: 書桌上有一把剪刀。

ex.en: Tom and Mary got up from their desks.
ex.zh: 湯姆和瑪麗從他們各自的書桌前站起身來。

ex.en: This desk cost me no less than 30000 yen.
ex.zh: 這張書桌花了我至少三萬日圓。

ex.en: You must get the job done before the deadline.
ex.zh: 你必須在期限前完成這項工作。

ex.en: Can they finish this before the deadline?
ex.zh: 他們能在期限前完成嗎？

ex.en: Wow, I can't believe they actually met the deadline for once.
ex.zh: 哇，真不敢相信他們這次居然趕上了截止日期。

ex.en: She has to make her own decisions.
ex.zh: 她要自己做決定。

ex.en: Why didn't you consult me before taking this decision?
ex.zh: 你做這個決定之前，為什麼不先問過我？

ex.en: We have some decisions to make.
ex.zh: 我們要做些決定。
